title: The column-generating-function conjecture for the first five columns of $M$
statement:
Let $M=(M_{n,k})_{n,k\geq 0}$ be the array associated with the row numerators of the generating functions of $T(n,m)$. For a fixed column $k$, write its generating function as $\sum_{n\geq 0}M_{n,k}x^n$, and let $N_4(x)$ be the polynomial displayed below.

**First-five-column conjecture.** The generating functions for columns $0,1,2,3,4$ of $M$, in that order, are

$$
\frac{1}{1-x},\qquad \frac{1}{(1-x)^2(1-x-x^2)},
$$

$$
\frac{1-x^2-x^3-x^4+x^5}{(1-x)^3(1-x-x^2)^2(1-2x-x^2+x^3)},
$$

$$
\frac{1+x-6x^2-15x^3+21x^4+35x^5-13x^6-51x^7+3x^8+21x^9+5x^{10}+x^{11}-5x^{12}-x^{13}-x^{14}}{(1-x)^4(1-x-x^2)^3(1-2x-x^2+x^3)^2(1-2x-3x^2+x^3+x^4)},
$$

and

$$
\frac{N_4(x)}{(1-x)^5(1-x-x^2)^4(1-2x-x^2+x^3)^3(1-2x-3x^2+x^3+x^4)^2(1-3x-3x^2+4x^3+x^4-x^5)},
$$

where

$$
\begin{aligned}
N_4(x)={}&1+4x-31x^2-67x^3+348x^4+418x^5-1893x^6-1084x^7+4326x^8+4295x^9-7680x^{10}-9172x^{11}+9104x^{12}\\
&+11627x^{13}-5483x^{14}-10773x^{15}+1108x^{16}+7255x^{17}+315x^{18}-3085x^{19}-228x^{20}+669x^{21}+102x^{22}\\
&-23x^{23}-45x^{24}-16x^{25}+11x^{26}+2x^{27}-x^{28}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The claim records explicit rational generating functions for the first five columns of $M$. It is an empirical conjecture associated with OEIS sequence A205497, and the supplied material gives no evidence that it has been proved.
source_name: Guoce Xin and Yueming Zhong, “Proving some conjectures on Kekulé numbers for certain benzenoids by using Chebyshev polynomials”, arXiv:2201.02376 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.02376

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2022).
